style.architecture: TEA with Browser.element: one Model record in Main (a field per widget), one update, one view; a Msg constructor per widget wrapping the widget's Msg (Html.map)
style.components: one module per widget (Model, Msg, init, update, view, decoder), written out from its description: a record field per state field, a Msg constructor per message, a case branch per message with the ops as record updates, the view tree as Html code; nothing shared but Ui's generic helpers (widget, when, option, nextId, toggleDone, onNumberInput)
style.types: int Int, bool Bool, text and enum String (options as data in the view and in a case for cycle), list a List of a type alias per list built by its positional constructor
style.derived: computed in view; an if is a let binding of the view function
style.conditionals: a view function per conditional section, called as Ui.when condition (viewSection model), which renders an empty text node while the condition fails
style.crossReads: the view takes the Model of each widget it reads, before its own
style.lists: Html.Keyed (Keyed.ul / Keyed.ol) with a viewXItem function per list
style.externalEvents: one incoming port; Json.Decode into the app's messages (serverSet → the widget's Replaced, notify → the feed's Notified, tick → Tick calling each time-driven widget's tick, snapshot → GotSnapshot)
style.events: onInput for text inputs and the select, onClick for buttons and checkboxes, Ui.onNumberInput (an integer in range, else no message) for number inputs
style.formatting: as elm-format 0.8.8 writes it; elm.json lists only the dependencies the app imports
style.build: elm make --optimize, then uglify-js compress (pure_funcs) and mangle passes, as the Elm guide recommends

style.components: one module per widget (bits, reducer, initial state, DOM factory with a static template whose bound elements are found by data-role, emptiness or a marker), each written from that widget's description; nothing interpreted at runtime
style.state: one immutable TEA model; the app reducer routes messages to the widgets' reducers
style.updates: reducers are tables of arms by message tag; each arm returns the compile-time dirty bits and values of the fields it writes, merged into the slice by the app; a static patch per widget runs only the bindings whose bits are set, batched in a microtask
style.externalEvents: through the same reducer (send); serverSet and snapshot mark every bit of the widgets they replace; tick goes to the time-driven widgets
style.crossWidgetReads: a reader has one bit per field it reads; the app patch sets it when the source's bit is dirty (one line per read)
style.lists: keyed by id: changed rows patched, gone rows removed, misplaced nodes moved in one walk
style.conditionals: branches built once with the template, swapped for an empty comment while hidden, with their own nested patch
style.events: addEventListener on each element; the handler builds a message and sends it
style.build: Vite with no framework plugin, production defaults, hidden source maps

style.components: one component per widget, in its own file, written from the widget's description; no shared kinds
style.state: one createStore for the whole dashboard, shared through a context; widgets use path setters on their slice, produce for click messages; readers read other widgets' slices
style.externalEvents: store.receive(msg); serverSet and snapshot through reconcile(…, { key: 'id' }); tick written out per time-driven int
style.derived: plain expressions in the JSX, one fine-grained binding each
style.events: onClick/onInput (delegated), onChange for checkboxes and selects; number inputs send only integers within range
style.build: Vite + vite-plugin-solid, production defaults, hidden source maps

style.approach: compiled dirty checking, per widget: an event re-runs the bindings of the widget it touched (and of the widgets reading it), writing a DOM property only when its value changed
style.components: one function per widget, written out in full from that widget's description (state, template, handlers, setter, bindings, tick); no shared per-kind factories, no data rows, no interpreter
style.state: plain mutable variables: locals of the widget's function, module variables for the fields other widgets read, a record for feed lists; external replacements are deep-copied and assigned through the widget's setter
style.templates: one static HTML string per widget (texts escaped at build time, no end tags at its end, a text's static prefix in it), hoisted into a table in page order; nodes are found by their position in the template (a distance from the previous binding's), once
style.handlers: one arrow function per control, given to the controls in document order, compiled from the message's ops; small generic helpers (next option, add an item); an int add checks only the bound it can pass
style.lists: keyed by id, reconciled in place by the runtime; item template and item bindings are the widget's own code
style.conditionals: a binding that swaps one node with an empty text node
style.events: one delegated click and input listener that calls the target's handler
style.derived: expressions compiled to JavaScript inside the bindings; a reader's whole binding list is added to each source widget's list (compile-time dependency); no memoization
style.time: each time-driven field pushes its own tick function; a tick digests only the widgets whose gate is on
style.build: Vite production build, no plugin, hidden source maps

style.components: one block per widget in the app's dashboard function (its factory inlined, as it is called once): its initial model, its own reducer (a table of arms by message tag, written out from its ops), template and bindings; only generic helpers are shared
style.state: each instance's model in its own closure; send(tag, value) runs the widget's reducer arm for that tag and schedules that instance's binding list
style.updates: one patch function per instance, every DOM write skipped when unchanged; derived texts compiled to template literals; batched in a microtask
style.crossWidget: a reader reads the earlier widgets' models from the frame's registry (instances in page order, w1 first) in patch; its instance, made by the frame's reader, has its patch watch them
style.externalEvents: serverSet/snapshot replace instance models; notify sends a feed widget its Notify message; tick calls the widgets of a shared running set, each subscribing while its gate is on
style.lists: runtime keyed list by item.id: patch changed rows, one forward placement pass when order or membership changes
style.dom: one static template per widget (trailing end tags left out), inserted with its section by insertAdjacentHTML, elements addressed by document order; one template per list row, cloned per new item, its elements an array
style.conditionals: node in the template; while hidden, an empty text node holds its place
style.events: messages numbered so the template's controls take tags 0, 1, 2, … in document order (then each row's controls), attached by position by the runtime's wire: a button or checkbox sends its message on click (a list row's with the item id), a text input, select or number input its tag with its value on input; messages are sent as send(tag, value); number inputs send valueAsNumber and the reducer takes integers within range only
style.build: Vite production build, no framework plugin, hidden source maps

style.track: prototype: no framework implements this strategy
style.components: one module per widget, each written out from its own description; DOM built once from one static HTML string, elements referred to by their place in document order (E[n]); conditional sections swapped out by when while hidden; list rows built with createElement
style.messages: erased for DOM events: each update arm is inlined into the action its control calls, which writes the widget's fields in place
style.updates: each action schedules the per-field binding groups of the fields it writes (known at compile time), held by place in the widget's binding table G; one microtask flush
style.derived: a binding reading another widget adds itself at mount to the group of the field it reads in that widget's binding table (R[widget][group]); the writing action schedules the group
style.lists: keyed: add and remove schedule their row's edit, toggle its row's binding; other edits replace the array and reconcile by id in one forward pass
style.externalEvents: receive(msg): serverSet and snapshot replace a widget's state (a copy) and run all its bindings and its readers; tick and notify call the widgets' external arms
style.build: Vite with no framework plugin, production defaults, hidden source maps

style.architecture: The Elm Architecture: Tea.element, one Model record in Main, one update, one view (markup)
style.components: one module per widget (Model, init, Msg, update, view, replace; tick and notify where it needs them); Main only routes
style.routing: one Msg constructor per widget wrapping its Msg, plus Pushed for host events; Html.map in view
style.crossReads: a widget that reads earlier widgets takes their Models as extra arguments of view
style.conditional: if holes with an empty fragment
style.derived: expressions written out in the widget's view (interpolation or markup holes)
style.helpers: Ui: intIn (integer within limits) and shown (number input text), independent of every widget
style.externalEvents: project platform layer Push.onPush (Sub.on over a window event), read with a schema declaration and derived codecs
style.inputs: controlled inputs; an int with a number input keeps its typed text beside its last valid number

attribution: source maps: node_modules → runtime; unmapped bundler output → tooling (counted with runtime); the adapter file → adapter (excluded); everything else → app. Brotli split: runtime = brotli(runtime+tooling); app = brotli(app JS) − runtime.
